summary:
I’m a Chartered Accountant having 3 years 10 months of post-qualification experience in Big 4's. Actively
looking for the opportunities wherein I could adapt my knowledge, experience and analytical thinking to
develop effective management techniques by proactive research and ensure protection of interest of
Industry and emerge as good corporate professional.

bullets: Leading end-to-end audit engagements for Canada & US based clients across various industries, ensuring compliance with IFRS and US GAAP standards.
Led the team of 4 professionals for audit services which includes review of their work, status of the tasks assigned to them.

Performing substantive testing, analytical procedures, and control testing to assess financial statement accuracy and internal control effectiveness for the key areas in the balance sheet and profit & loss accounts.
Coordinating with onshore teams and audit clients to address technical accounting issues and resolve audit queries efficiently.
Assisted Managers in the performance of complicated and priority tasks.
Assisted & performed Statutory audits of various private limited and Public limited companies which are engaged in various sectors like pharmaceutical, techonological, fashion retail etc.
Performed the initial planning activities including Walkthroughs documentation of all business processes.

Performed the control testings and Evaluated the effectiveness of internal controls to ensure they are operating as designed and effectively mitigating risks in key business processes (Fixed Assets, Inventory, Payroll, Revenue etc.).

Supported clients in preparation of year-end reconciliation & Financial Statements and ensured Financial Statements prepared are in compliance with Ind AS, other accounting principles and applicable laws without any misstatements.
Managed a team of 6 members for a Group reporting engagement of a US entity and evaluated there work for quality and compliance.
Performed Variance analysis periodically for financial statement line items to identify the root cause of the variance
Held responsible for Bookkeeping and helped in Finalization of books for different concerns like Proprietorships, Partnership Firms & companies for filing of income tax returns.
Assisted in the performance of the Statutory audits, Stock audits & Bank audits.
Assisted and worked on the GST returns for the clients.
Vouching and Verifications of Books of Accounts.

entries.institution: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India
